name: Pushing Assault (Combat)
body:
Prerequisite(s): Improved Unarmed Strike, Karate, Power Attack, BAB +4

Benefit(s): While employing the karate style, you may choose to attempt a pushing assault as part of any attack made on your turn against a creature of your size or smaller. Compare your attack roll against your target’s CMD. If your roll meets or exceeds your target’s CMD, you may choose to push the target back 5 feet. If you are using Power Attack, the penalty does not apply for this CMB check.

Special: A monk may use his monk level in place of his BAB for this feat’s benefit. A monk can select Pushing Assault as a bonus feat at 6th level or higher.
